name: Noted
description: Noted is a calm task manager that turns chaotic days into clear, finishable plans. Capture tasks in seconds, time-block your calendar, and build streaks with gentle reminders — without the noise of traditional productivity apps.

name: Maison
description: Maison is a curated furniture store for warm minimalism. Browse editorial collections, filter by material and room, and check out in a few taps — with carbon-neutral delivery and a 30-day home trial on every piece.

name: Orbit
description: Orbit is a photo-first social network for people who chase light. Share moments, discover creators through a human-curated explore feed, and grow an audience with built-in insights — no algorithmic doomscrolling.

name: Bright
description: Bright makes learning a daily habit with bite-size video courses from working professionals. Follow adaptive study plans, chat with an AI tutor, earn shareable certificates, and keep a streak with just 15 minutes a day.

name: Vitalis
description: Vitalis is a habit companion for water, movement, mindfulness and sleep. Log in seconds, get nudges from an adaptive AI coach, find nearby studios on the map, and watch streaks compound into a healthier routine.
